quest.title: Custom Gift Envelope No. 2
quest.description: Someone seems interested in creating a Gift Envelope...

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: Hmm, I should probably take a look at the other envelopes first...

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: #Oh, {NICKNAME}! It's been a while... Why do you look so surprised?

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: To see a warrior like me enjoying Lantern Rite?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't think I've ever seen you relax...

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: The Tenryou Commission bears a great responsibility to the people. As a member, I cannot afford to relax most of the time.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: Perhaps people think of me as a single-minded warrior, completely out of place in a festive and refined neighborhood like Hanamizaka.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: But, letting down my guard means allowing crime to slip through... That is not only a detriment to my duty but to the atmosphere of Hanamizaka as a whole.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: The most I can do is take advantage of any spare moment that comes my way.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: Ah, apologies. I shouldn't talk about such serious matters during the holidays.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: I'm trying to make a gift envelope, but it's not quite coming together. Perhaps you could give me some advice?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure, let me think about it for a second...

talks.objective: Complete the Gift Envelope with Kujou Sara

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: I see. This method produced a great result.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: I appreciate the help. This souvenir really makes this trip worthwhile.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: #You have my thanks, {NICKNAME}. The next time you visit Inazuma, I will treat you to a round of tea.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure, let me think about it for a second...
